tasks.task: Recommend a price for one product, service or package

items.when: When costs jump, margins slip or the owner asks whether to raise prices, to set the steps
When you have costs, rival prices and buyer evidence and need a price with the maths shown
Before you settle, to get three test prices set against the buyer's gain and your pick
When a price is proposed, to see break-even volume and the margin of safety
When the owner prices by cost alone and ignores how the price itself signals value

tasks.task: Build the cost floor and a margin table

items.when: When you have a price and every cost and need the true margin per unit
When costs fall per order, not per unit, and you need profit on a typical order
When you need the lowest price that still works after targets and selling costs
Before a partner checks the table, to confirm units match and rough inputs are marked

tasks.task: Put rival prices on the same basis and pick a position

items.when: When you have rival links and need each one's published pricing and positioning collected
When you have costs and rival offers and need a price per product and rules for rival moves
When rivals crowd one price band, to plot them and find a corner you can own
When the client wants to charge more than rivals and needs a reason buyers accept

tasks.task: Gather buyer evidence on what they would pay

items.when: When no buyer evidence sits behind a price and the client needs questions for calls or a survey
When the client can survey customers and needs two questions that turn into a price range
When the client will talk to buyers and the draft questions lead the answer
Before the survey goes out, to find biased wording and questions nobody can answer
When answers are in, to mark which ones you can trust before they set a price

tasks.task: Design a good, better, best package ladder

items.when: When you need three tiers with a value metric, contents, prices and a margin check
Before you fix the tiers, to draft a ladder fast and see why the middle one should win
When you have price survey data and need price points and tiers built from it
When the tiers are product bundles and need savings wording and a test plan
When tiers are set, to check the order and anchor make value clear without tricks

tasks.task: Design a per-seat, usage or subscription pricing model

items.when: Before the model, to pick the one number to charge by and what each plan holds
When software needs a value metric, a tier layout and pricing tests to run
When pay-as-you-go may fit better than seats and buyers must be able to predict the bill
When a free tier is planned and its limits must win paid users without anger
When you want one guided run from revenue model to tiers, price page and a safe test

tasks.task: Write discount rules with reasons, caps and end dates

items.when: When discounts are given by habit and each needs a reason, cap, trade and end date
When a sales team quotes prices and needs a discount matrix and approval limits
When one deal asks for a deep discount, to see its margin and risky terms
When several discounts show at once, to find where they clash or stack

tasks.task: Show the sales lift a discount needs to break even

items.when: When someone proposes a discount and you need the extra sales it must win, in one minute
When a sale or price change is planned, to find the deepest cut the margin allows
When fixed costs matter too, to see break-even volume before and after the discount

tasks.task: Plan a sale or promotion with an honest deadline

items.when: Before planning a promotion, to set the depth, reason and end date it must keep to
When a straight discount is the default, to try a gift, bundle or pre-order instead
When you have margins and need a sale offer with a true reason and a real deadline
When the sale needs a main offer, backups and a plan if the first one stalls
Before the sale goes live, to check reference prices, savings and deadlines are honest

tasks.task: Plan a safe price test

items.when: When there is a pricing question worth testing and tests must run one at a time
When a test needs its decision rule and stop rule set before it starts
When you need the best price to try and three outcome cases from costs and sales data
Before the test starts, to see if visits and orders are enough and how many weeks it needs
When tests repeat and someone must plan each one, read the result and keep a log
When there is no buyer evidence yet and the survey, price model and test should run in order

tasks.task: Read out a finished price test

items.when: When a test has ended and needs reading against its comparison group and its rules
When you have the test numbers and need to know if the result is real
When tests repeat and each needs a readiness check before and an honest verdict after
When the owner already believes the new price worked and reads every number that way

tasks.task: Show what a past price change or discount really did

items.when: When a past price change or promotion needs reading against a comparison group
When the change fell in a busy season, to separate the trend and season from the price effect
When sales held but something else moved, to trace what the change caused next

tasks.task: Plan a price rise for existing customers

items.when: When the rise is likely and needs review, approval and rollout steps in order
Before committing, to score whether the offer and buyer signals support a rise
When input costs rose and you need how much margin a given price rise wins back
When some repeat buyers are already drifting and should be handled apart from the rest
Before rollout, to trace what the rise causes next for sales staff and key accounts

tasks.task: Write the price rise notice to customers

items.when: When the rise is approved and customers and key accounts each need their notice
When you want a second draft with a different opening to compare against the first
When staff will take calls about the rise and need an answer for each doubt
Before sending, to check each reason given for the rise is true and not missing context

tasks.task: Build a clear offer with a price and a promise

items.when: When an offer is vague or converts weakly and needs a price and a promise the client can keep
When you want a second version with different value framing, bonuses and payment terms
When buyers fear the risk and the offer needs a guarantee sized to what refunds cost
When the client reaches for a discount and needs an offer that keeps margin instead
When the offer is drafted, to score it and get the three changes that matter most
When the offer lists features and the buyer cannot see what they get or why now

tasks.task: Shape offers for each buyer type, entry to full service

items.when: When you have reviews or survey answers and need buyer groups before shaping offers
When one offer serves everyone, to rewrite it for narrower buyers each with a price
When the client needs a first step, rising rungs and what moves a buyer up each one
When one rung is weak and needs honest limits, bonuses, a guarantee and a name

tasks.task: Raise order value with bundles and add-ons

items.when: When you have a sales export and need a shipping threshold, bundles and add-ons to check
When one hero product sells alone, to try bundle tiers, a default and quantity breaks
When offers follow the first sale and need an order and a fallback for each no

tasks.task: Write pricing page copy for hesitating visitors

items.when: When buyers stall at the price and the page needs a value case, a guarantee and honest reasons
Before rewriting, to get several honest angles on why visitors hesitate
When the page shows several plans and needs their order and anchor laid out
When the page needs an FAQ that answers each price doubt buyers raise
Before the page goes live, to check savings, fees, deadlines and free claims

tasks.task: Check how prices, savings and deadlines are shown

items.when: Before a price page, sale, ad, email or quote goes live, to test each price claim
When a discount needs showing as a percent or an amount and the sale price laid out
When you have a full and a sale price and want the clearest ways to show the saving
When several discounts appear on one page, to find where they contradict each other

tasks.task: Price a service, course or digital product

items.when: When the service or course needs a price range with cost floor and buyer evidence
When a service firm needs an hourly, day and project rate from pay, costs and billable hours
When the product is a course or ebook and needs price digits, labels and launch terms
When value to the buyer is far above cost, to compare three prices against that gain

tasks.task: Check wholesale and channel prices leave margin

items.when: When a retailer takes a cut and you need margin per unit after promos and freight
When shelf prices must sit sensibly against rivals in the same store
When trade discounts and retailer promotions need caps and a reason for each

always.when: Before pricing work on a live site, to record the prices shown today with their dates
Before any price maths goes out, to check units and carry rough inputs through as ranges

helpers.when: When the cost build is unclear and true cost per product or job must be worked out first
When buyer evidence needs proper interviews or a survey run and analysed
When the pricing page or offer page needs full copy, not only the price logic
When a price test must be set up and run on a live site
When reading a past price change needs sales data cleaned and compared by group
When new tiers change how the product is positioned and launched

gaps: No library item reads the effect of a past price change against a comparison group; only the kit skill does
No library item measures promotion lift and payback from sales data, with sales pulled forward and taken from other products
No library item checks price display against consumer rules by country: reference prices, added fees, free claims and deadlines
No library item plans a price rise rollout for existing customers: who is exempt, old-price terms, timing and expected losses
No library item prices a service as day rate, retainer or fixed fee, or builds a three-option proposal
No library item sets annual against monthly plan discounts or billing terms
No library item builds a wholesale or volume price list with quantity breaks for trade buyers
No library item handles pricing across countries and currencies
No library item prices a restaurant or café menu by dish margin and popularity
No library item turns price survey answers into a too-cheap to too-expensive range chart
